gemini.title: Uv902 UK Armed Forces Veterans Households Oa
gemini.abstract: Uv902 UK Armed Forces Veterans Households Oa is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to uv902 uk armed forces veterans households oa.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: geography_code
columns.description: Code assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: household_contains_no_uk_armed_forces_veterans
columns.description: Recorded census measure for the category "household contains no UK armed forces veterans" in the represented area. Units and population base require the source table.

columns.name: household_contains_at_least_one_uk_armed_forces_veteran
columns.description: Recorded census measure for the category "household contains at least one UK armed forces veteran" in the represented area. Units and population base require the source table.
